name: Reformer Mermaid
body: sits sideways on the reformer carriage with her legs folded to one side, one hand pressing the footbar and the other arm sweeping up and over her head in a long side bend, ribs lengthening away from her hips.

name: Reformer Side Splits
body: sits on the reformer carriage with both feet in the straps and her legs opening wide to either side in a long straddle, arms reaching forward and spine tall.

name: Reformer Skater
body: balances on one foot on the reformer carriage with the other leg swept behind her and her torso hinged forward, arms out to the sides, like a skater gliding on ice.

name: Reverse Fly
body: hinges forward with her chest resting on a raised padded bench, a light dumbbell in each hand hanging below her shoulders, sweeping both arms out to the sides with elbows softly bent. Rear shoulders softly washed in sage green.

name: Reverse Lunge with Bicep Curl
body: steps one leg straight back into a reverse lunge with the back knee lowered close to the floor, holding a dumbbell in each hand and curling both to her shoulders with elbows pinned to her ribs. Biceps and glutes softly washed in terracotta.

name: Reverse Lunge with Knee Drive
body: drives one knee up to hip height after stepping back into a reverse lunge, standing tall on the support leg with the other foot lifted and arms swinging. Quadriceps and hip flexors softly washed in terracotta.

name: Rolling Like a Ball
body: balances on her tailbone with her knees hugged tight to her chest and her forehead drawn toward them, feet lifted and spine rounded into a tight ball, hands clasping her shins. Abdominals softly washed in sage green.

name: Russian Twist
body: sits with her knees bent and heels resting on the floor, leaning back at forty-five degrees with her spine long, hands clasped together and rotated to one side of her ribs. Obliques softly washed in dusty rose.

name: Russian Twist with Pulse
body: sits leaning back at forty-five degrees with her knees bent and heels light on the floor, hands clasped in front of her ribs and rotated to one side in a small pulse. Obliques softly washed in dusty rose.

name: Russian Twist with Weight
body: sits leaning back at forty-five degrees holding a medicine ball with both hands, knees bent and heels resting on the floor, twisting the ball across to one side of her ribs. Obliques softly washed in dusty rose.

name: Scissor
body: lies on her back with both legs lifted and straight, scissoring them apart with one leg high toward the ceiling and the other low above the floor, lower back pressed down and hands at her sides. Abdominals softly washed in sage green.

name: Scissor Kick
body: lies on her back with her hands beneath her hips and both legs straight and lifted, one leg swung high and the other low in a wide scissor, toes pointed. Abdominals softly washed in sage green.

name: Seated Banded Hip Abduction
body: sits on the edge of a padded bench with a loop band around both thighs just above her knees, feet planted and spine tall, pushing her knees apart against the band. Glutes softly washed in dusty rose.

name: Seated Hip Abduction
body: sits in a hip-abduction machine with her back against the pad and both legs pressed outward against the padded arms, knees bent and feet on the plates. Glutes softly washed in dusty rose.

name: Seated Knee Tuck
body: sits with her knees bent and her feet just off the floor, leaning back with her spine long and drawing her knees in toward her chest with her hands reaching forward. Abdominals softly washed in sage green.

name: Seated Leg Curl
body: sits in a leg-curl machine with her back against the pad and her lower legs hooked under the padded roller, knees bent and heels drawn back beneath the seat. Hamstrings softly washed in sage green.

name: Side Kick Front and Back
body: lies on her side propped on one forearm with both legs long and stacked, lifting the top leg and sweeping it forward and back in a controlled arc, foot flexed. Glutes and abductors softly washed in sage green.

name: Single Leg Box Jump
body: balances on one leg on top of a sturdy wooden plyo box, the other knee lifted in front of her with the foot off the box, arms out lightly for balance. Quadriceps and glutes softly washed in terracotta.

name: Single Leg Squat to Bench
body: lowers into a single-leg squat with one leg reaching forward off the floor and her hips sinking back toward a padded bench behind her, torso hinged slightly forward. Quadriceps and glutes softly washed in terracotta.

name: Single Leg Stretch
body: lies on her back with her head and shoulders curled up, drawing one knee in toward her chest with both hands while the other leg extends long and low above the floor. Abdominals softly washed in sage green.

name: Skater Hop
body: is caught in mid-air hopping sideways from one foot to the other, landing leg softly bent and the other sweeping behind, torso hinged forward with arms out for balance. Glutes and abductors softly washed in terracotta.

name: Skater Hop with Touch
body: hinges forward on one bent leg with the other swept behind her, one hand reaching down to touch the floor in front of her foot, other arm reaching back. Glutes and hamstrings softly washed in terracotta.

name: Skipping
body: is airborne in a skip with one knee lifted high in front and the opposite foot just off the floor behind, arms swinging in opposition, torso tall. Calves and hip flexors softly washed in terracotta.

name: Speed Skater
body: glides low on one deeply bent leg with the other leg extended out behind and across, torso hinged forward and both arms swept behind her in a skater's crouch. Glutes and abductors softly washed in sage green.

name: Split Jump
body: is airborne in a split jump with her legs scissored wide front and back and knees softly bent, arms lifted, torso upright. Quadriceps and glutes softly washed in terracotta.

name: Sprint in Place
body: sprints on the spot with one knee driven up in front and the opposite leg extended back on the ball of the foot, torso leaning slightly forward with arms pumping hard. Quadriceps and hip flexors softly washed in terracotta.

name: Squat
body: sinks into a bodyweight squat with her feet shoulder-width apart and hips back, thighs lowering toward parallel, chest lifted and arms reaching forward for balance. Quadriceps and glutes softly washed in terracotta.

name: Squat Hold
body: holds a low squat with her thighs near parallel to the floor, heels down and chest lifted, arms clasped together in front of her chest. Quadriceps and glutes softly washed in terracotta.

name: Squat to Calf Raise
body: rises from a low squat onto the balls of both feet in a tall calf raise, legs straight and ankles lifted, arms long at her sides. Calves and quadriceps softly washed in terracotta.

name: Squat to Overhead Press
body: stands with feet shoulder-width apart pressing a dumbbell in each hand straight overhead, arms long above her head, knees softly bent and ribs stacked over her hips. Shoulders softly washed in sage green.

name: Squat to Stand
body: hinges forward to hold her toes with both hands, dropping her hips into a deep squat with knees wide and chest lifted, spine long. Hamstrings and adductors softly washed in sage green.

name: Standing Kickback
body: hinges forward with both hands resting on a padded bench, one leg straight and kicking back and up behind her with the toes turned down and hips square. Glutes softly washed in dusty rose.

name: Standing Side Leg Lift
body: stands tall holding a bench for balance, lifting one straight leg out to the side with the toes turned out and hips level. Abductors softly washed in sage green.

name: Stationary Lunge
body: is in a stationary split stance with both knees bent, the front shin vertical over the ankle and the back knee lowered beneath her hip, torso upright with hands on hips. Quadriceps and glutes softly washed in terracotta.

name: Straight Leg Raise
body: lies on her back with one leg straight and lifted toward the ceiling and the other bent with the foot flat on the floor, holding the lifted leg with both hands behind the thigh, head and shoulders lifted. Abdominals softly washed in sage green.

name: Swiss Ball Hamstring Curl
body: lies on her back with her heels resting on top of a large exercise ball and her hips lifted so her body forms one straight line from shoulders to heels, arms long at her sides. Hamstrings and glutes softly washed in sage green.

name: The Hundred
body: lies on her back with her head and shoulders curled up off the floor, arms long and straight by her sides just above the floor, both legs lifted and held straight out at a low angle. Abdominals softly washed in sage green.

name: Thruster Push Press
body: stands with feet shoulder-width apart driving a dumbbell in each hand from her shoulders to overhead, arms locking out above her head with knees softly bent from the dip. Shoulders and quadriceps softly washed in terracotta.

name: Toe Tap
body: lies on her back with her knees stacked over her hips and both feet lifted off the floor, lowering one foot to tap the floor lightly with the toes while the other knee stays still, arms long at her sides. Abdominals softly washed in sage green.

name: Toe Touch
body: stands with her legs straight and hinges forward from the hips to reach her fingertips toward her toes, spine long and knees soft. Hamstrings softly washed in sage green.

name: Tricep Dip
body: dips with her hands gripping the edge of a stable bench behind her and her legs extended forward with heels on the floor, elbows bent behind her and hips lowered toward the floor. Triceps softly washed in dusty rose.

name: Tricep Push Up
body: holds a narrow push-up with both hands planted close together under her chest, elbows brushing past her ribs and body in one straight line from head to heels. Triceps softly washed in dusty rose.

name: Tuck Jump
body: is airborne at the top of a tuck jump with both knees drawn up toward her chest and both arms reaching forward, feet clear of the floor. Abdominals softly washed in terracotta.

name: Tuck Jump to Squat
body: lands from a jump into a low squat with her knees bent and hips back, feet flat on the floor and chest lifted, arms reaching forward. Quadriceps softly washed in terracotta.

name: V Up
body: balances on her tailbone in a V shape with both legs lifted straight and her torso lifted to meet them, arms reaching toward her toes, spine long. Abdominals softly washed in dusty rose.

name: V Up Tuck
body: balances on her tailbone with her knees drawn in toward her chest and her torso lifted to meet them in a tight tuck, feet off the floor and arms extended. Abdominals softly washed in dusty rose.

name: Walking Lunge with Twist
body: is in a forward lunge with her front knee bent over the ankle and the back leg extended long, torso rotated toward the front leg with both hands together at her chest. Obliques and glutes softly washed in terracotta.

name: Wall Sit
body: sits with her back flat against a wall and her hips lowered until her thighs are parallel to the floor, knees stacked over her ankles and hands resting on her thighs. Quadriceps softly washed in terracotta.

name: Weighted Sit Up
body: sits up from lying on her back holding a dumbbell against her chest with both hands, knees bent with feet anchored, torso lifted to an upright angle. Abdominals softly washed in dusty rose.

name: Windshield Wiper
body: lies on her back with her two legs held straight and pressed together as one glued unit — feet touching, knees together — with both legs angled over to one side at about forty-five degrees from vertical, like a single windscreen wiper arm swept to one side. Her arms are stretched out wide on the floor in a T and her shoulders stay flat. Her legs must both point to the same side: never one leg up and one leg down, and never split apart. Obliques softly washed in sage green.
